items.text: The “safe “safeguarding” - guarding” “safeguarding” clause of the naval treaty being drawn up here, which the naval delegates themselves have kept rigorously secret until after final approval of the home government, was revealed today in dispatches from Tokio. The clause provides for an increase in the navies of either Japan, America or Great Britain—the three signatories to the projected limitation treaty—if the building programs of non-signatory nations are considered excessive.
